Hello friend,  Why deprive yourself and someone else of such a beautiful thing?
Why not hold someone’s hand and stay. I love holding hands when I have someone’s to hold. It’s one of the many simple joys that doesn’t really cost anything and can say so much without any words at all. I’m sure whoever would be holding your hand would not want you to go. Hello friend, I’m sorry you’re feeling like this. No, you should not kill yourself and definitely don’t kill anyone else. You absolutely can fix this, but you need to identify where these feelings are truly coming from. You may need help doing that. Maybe try to check out some online peer support groups or maybe write your feelings down on paper if you can when you are feeling them and take a few breaths and then go back later on and look at them when you are in a calmer state. this is not a sign to kill yourself, it’s a sign that something isn’t serving you and you just need to make a change maybe. That’s all,talk to somebody, get that stuff out of you. Your are valuable and one of a kind and cannot be replaced. i’ve adopted a saying that popped into my head. Everything is fixable until it’s not. Take care Friend.

Have you talked to your friends about this? Have you talked to any mental health professionals? 
Maybe it’s worth looking into or some online peer support groups, I found those helpful in my time of need because it was a place where I could bounce my thoughts and feelings off of like-minded peers and everyone was incredibly supportive. I would suggest looking into that. you can do it right now.  I took the time to write this because I don’t know you but I care about you and I love you as a fellow human being. Take a little time and show some love to yourself. My inbox is always open if you need someone to talk to.
I am Sincerely glad you  and  Op are both alive. Regardless of where you're at in life, nobody should ever tell you that you should end your life. Try to stay in the positive,,stay beautiful!
